artworks.title: A Seated Young Woman Holding a Letter
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting in a wooden chair in a side-facing position. She has turned her head slightly towards the viewer. The woman is elegantly dressed in a long gown with ruffled cuffs and a ruffled hem. She has delicate facial features, styled hair, and holds something in her left hand. There is a table on her left with a mirror and a decorative item. The background features subtle horizontal lines.

artworks.title: A Man in a Turban Reading to a Young Woman
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the waist up. The person on the left is positioned facing slightly towards the right, with their head tilted. This person has curly hair styled into an updo with ringlets hanging down and appears to be wearing an earring. They have a rounded face with a gentle expression and are wearing clothing with a ruffled collar. The second person, to the right, is seen in profile, wearing glasses. They are holding a quill or similar writing tool, pointing toward an open book with visible writing. The background is plain, focusing attention on the two figures.

artworks.title: The Bagpipe Player
artworks.artist: Jacques Dumont Le Romain, finished by Jean Daullé
artworks.medium: etching finished in engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man playing a bagpipe outdoors. He is facing left, dressed in a cloak and wide-brimmed hat with a feather. A seated dog looks up at him. Two figures, possibly dolls, are on the ground in front of him. Two children are seated behind him, one holding what looks like a doll. The background includes hilly terrain, trees, and a textured sky.

artworks.title: A Young Mother Carrying a Crib
artworks.artist: Jacques Dumont Le Romain, finished by Jean Daullé
artworks.medium: etching finished in engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a cradle with a sleeping infant while a young boy stands next to her. The woman has her eyes closed and wears a bonnet, long dress, cloak, and sturdy shoes. The boy looks up at the woman, holding a stick. The setting is outdoors with rugged terrain, a worn-down building, and a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: North Windmill in the Creuse Valley
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a windmill viewed from a low angle against the sky. The horizon is low in the frame where the windmill meets the ground. On the left are a few buildings and tall trees. The painting style includes dark lines and crosshatching for texture in monochrome shades. The contrast between the dark and light areas creates a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint  Anne
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts four people standing close together. There is an older woman on the left, a seated woman next to her, a young child standing in front of them, and a man behind and to the right. The background shows a ledge and part of a column or architectural feature.

artworks.title: Two Workmen at Tables (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and black/brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men leaning against a railing. The man on the left is bent forward, resting his right hand on the railing, with his left hand gesturing slightly forward. He wears a long coat, loose pants, and detailed footwear. The man on the right also leans forward with his right hand on the railing. His facial features suggest a profile view, and his attire includes a coat with rolled-up sleeves, loose clothing, and pants. The background is minimal, with lightly sketched lines indicating the setting. The illustration is done in a sketchy, monochrome style.

artworks.title: Spiritus sanctus Deus
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in red-brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon, trees, swirling clouds, a pathway with geometric patterns, and a monochromatic color palette dominated by warm sepia tones. The trees in the distance appear sketch-like while those closer by are more detailed, creating depth in the composition.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.artist: Elisha Kirkall after Perino del Vaga
artworks.medium: etching, mezzotint, engraving, and chiaroscuro woodcut, printed in ochre and brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: This is a painting of a classical scene with various figures interacting. In the center, a figure is seated on draped fabric, extending one arm towards a kneeling figure. On the left, a long-haired child stands with inscriptions around its head. The central figure is surrounded by other figures, some carrying loads. Behind them is an architectural structure with columns and foliage. In the background, an angelic figure oversees the scene. The painting is in monochromatic sepia tones and done in the style of Peter Paul Rubens.

artworks.title: Heimkehr (Homecoming)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a dark, shadowy scene. Both are walking closely together, with one slightly ahead of the other. Their facial features and hair are not clearly visible due to the low lighting. Both individuals wear long overcoats and hats, indicating they are dressed for cold weather. One person carries a softly glowing lantern, providing light. The background is dark, with faint lights or reflections hinting at the night or evening setting. The scene appears to be outdoors, likely on a path or street.

artworks.title: Weiblicher Studienkopf
artworks.medium: lithograph in green and black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a woman's face and upper shoulders. She has curly dark hair and a serene expression with her eyes looking directly at the viewer. The lighting creates a dramatic contrast between light and shadow on her face. The background is a dark, textured surface and the image is bordered by a plain, light-colored frame.

artworks.title: Seated Acolyte
artworks.medium: etching with roulette and aquatint on buff wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated young person in a luxurious chair. The person is sitting in a relaxed position, with their left arm on the armrest and their right hand resting on their lap. They have a youthful face with short curly hair, and are wearing a loose-fitting long garment with puffed sleeves, dark clothing, dark pants, and polished shoes. The background is a textured wall with a classic style.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Angels
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper, laid down on Liechtenstein collection mat
artworks.description: The image shows several figures. A woman holds a child. The woman, with a gentle expression, gazes at the child. The child has curly hair. An angelic figure holds an open book next to them. There is another figure behind the woman, holding a vessel. The background shows a landscape with buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Ph. Cl. A. de Thubières, Comte de Caylus
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in profile, seated or poised in a slightly turned position. The individual has a straight nose, full lips, and a high forehead. Their gaze is directed forward. The person's hair is styled in voluminous curls, and they are wearing a dark, richly textured coat with a visible portion of a shirt underneath, featuring a ruffled or lace collar at the neckline. There are no visible accessories or jewelry. The backdrop is dark and uniform.

artworks.title: God the Father Creating the Heavens
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in brown-red on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing illustrating a cosmic creation theme. The image shows a figure in flowing robes extending their arms amid swirling clouds and radiating energy. Below, there is a circular formation with a central point, suggesting a celestial motif with concentric rings. The use of light and dark shading creates a dynamic sense of movement and mystery.

artworks.title: The Artist's Left Hand
artworks.medium: ink handprint on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a black handprint on a beige background. The handprint is detailed with lines and curves, resembling fingerprint patterns.

artworks.title: Clemens Brentano
artworks.medium: pen and gray and black ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Honor of Wolfgang Ratjen's 70th Birthday
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up in a side profile, looking towards the right. He has distinct facial features and wavy hair. He is wearing a loose garment with a large collar draped over the chair's armrest. On the table in front of him, there is an open book and some stacked books. The background is detailed with a tapestry or wall adorned with various designs, including religious iconography, a rooster, and scenes reminiscent of religious or mythological narratives.

artworks.title: Vulcan and Cyclops Forging Cupid's Arrows
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 31.2 × 45 cm (12 5/16 × 17 11/16 in.), cut to image
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple nude figures with muscular physiques engaged in labor in a forge-like setting. The scene includes large stone structures and arches, as well as cherubic figures or putti in the foreground. The figures are shown working with tools, portraying a sense of activity and craftsmanship. The drawing showcases detailed depictions of the bodies and surrounding materials.

artworks.title: Icarus
artworks.artist: Hendrick Goltzius after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33.3 × 33.3 cm (13 1/8 × 13 1/8 in.) (roundel, cut within platemark)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Allen R. Adler and Frances Beatty
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular male figure in a dynamic pose, appearing as if falling or being projected backward. The figure's body is contorted, with arms extended, legs bent, and defined musculature. His head is tilted back with a grimace, and wild thick hair. The figure is unclothed. The background includes a circular frame with a scene of a smaller flying figure, a seascape with rugged mountainous islands, a cloudy sky, and sunlight rays. Classical script borders the circular frame.

artworks.title: Splinter Beach
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Max N. Berry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a riverside scene with a large ship and industrial buildings in the background. In the foreground, there are people along the river engaging in activities like swimming or preparing to enter the water. The drawing is in black and white, giving it a vintage quality. The ship dominates the mid-ground, with its towering funnel and hull cutting across the scene. In the background, a bridge stretches across the river, flanked by large industrial-style buildings. The texture and shading provide depth and contrast, emphasizing the atmosphere and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: tintype with applied color
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman shown from the shoulders up. She faces forward, directly looking at the viewer. Her hair is styled back with a dark ribbon. Her facial features are delicate, with fair skin, prominent cheekbones, and a composed expression. She is wearing a high neckline blouse with a decorative pattern, a dark jacket or dress, and a small bow tie with a brooch at the center. The woman accessorizes with small drop earrings. The portrait is set against a neutral background within an ornate wooden frame with gold trim and decorative patterns in the corners.

artworks.title: Cathedrale de Chartres, Côté Occidental, Porte Latérale de Droite, XIIe Siècle (Chartres Cathedral, West Side, Right Side Door, XII Century)
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The sculpture depicted in the image is a detailed relief adorning a stone archway. The subject consists of multiple figures, including a central seated figure surrounded by others. The sculpture is made from a light-colored stone, possibly limestone, blending with the surrounding masonry. The figures are intricately carved, depicting them in detailed garments, various postures, and gestures. The relief encompasses the arch and the columns on either side of the archway, with additional sculptural elements filling the tympanum and surrounding spandrels. The craftsmanship creates a three-dimensional representation.

artworks.title: Second Lieutenant Henry W. Hayden
artworks.medium: ambrotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew Szegedy-Maszak and Elizabeth Bobrick, in honor of Philip and Ina Trager
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up seated in a formal pose. He has a composed expression and gazes directly at the viewer. The man has dark, neatly styled hair and a beard with a mustache. He is dressed in a military uniform with prominent gold shoulder epaulettes and a row of buttons down the front. He is holding a sword, and in his other hand, rests a shako, a type of military hat, with crossed rifles insignia on the front. The portrait is encased in an ornate gold-colored frame with intricate designs around the border. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Whistler Asleep
artworks.medium: drypoint on pale green-gray paper
artworks.description: This image shows a sketch of a man depicted from the upper body upwards, in a reclining position. His head is tilted slightly back. His facial features are detailed with a mustache and short curly hair. He appears to be wearing a garment, likely a shirt or jacket, as suggested by the folds of fabric sketched around his shoulders and upper torso. The artwork is monochromatic, with the background fading into light sketch marks. The sketch does not show any distinct objects or jewelry. The artist's signature can be seen in the lower right corner of the sketch.
